nodes.description: Ownable owner address; written in constructor and transferOwnership, read by onlyOwner.
Token balance mapping; mutated in _transfer and initialized in the constructor.
Nested allowance mapping; mutated in _approve, read by allowance and transferFrom.
Total token supply, set once in the constructor to 1e9 * 10**decimals.
Token decimals set to 6 in the constructor and exposed via decimals().
Token name string 'EASY.GAME' set in the constructor.
Token symbol string 'EG' set in the constructor.
Constructor: sets decimals, supply, name, symbol and mints the whole supply to owner().
External ERC20 transfer; moves msg.sender's tokens through _transfer.
External ERC20 transferFrom; spends allowance via sub and calls _transfer and _approve.
External approval; delegates to _approve with msg.sender as owner.
Increases the caller's allowance using SafeMath add.
Decreases the caller's allowance using SafeMath sub.
Internal transfer: checks zero addresses and updates _balances for sender and recipient.
Internal approval: validates addresses and writes _allowances[owner][spender].
View returning _balances[account].
View returning _allowances[owner][spender].
Owner-only function that replaces _owner after a zero-address check.
Modifier requiring _owner == msg.sender; the access-control gate of the contract.
Library helper that forwards native value with a raw call to a payable recipient.
Private helper performing an arbitrary low-level call with value after an isContract check.
Wrapper that performs the token call through Address.functionCall and checks the returned bool.
Public library entry point that forwards to _functionCallWithValue with value 0.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, sender and allowance holder.
{value: amount} raw call to an arbitrary recipient inside Address.sendValue.
Arbitrary target.call{value: weiValue}(data) executed inside _functionCallWithValue.

Amount argument of transfer/transferFrom/approve.

Allowance increment consumed by increaseAllowance.
Allowance decrement consumed by decreaseAllowance.
Boolean returned by the low-level call in Address._functionCallWithValue.

edges.reason: msg.sender is supplied as the sender argument of _transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender becomes the owner of the allowance in approve.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner, comparing _owner with caller-controlled msg.sender.
onlyOwner requires _owner == msg.sender, an authorization decision driven by caller input.
Constructor (Ownable initializer path) uses msg.sender as the initial owner.
account indexes the _balances mapping read by balanceOf.
recipient flows into _transfer to credit the destination balance.
amount flows into _transfer to size the balance update.
transfer delegates all state mutation to _transfer.
sender is the debited account in transferFrom.
amount is used both for the transfer and for the allowance check.
transferFrom calls _transfer to move balances.
transferFrom calls _approve to write back the reduced allowance.
spender is the allowance key written by approve.
amount is the allowance value written by approve.
addedValue is added to the current allowance in increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is removed from the current allowance in decreaseAllowance.
increaseAllowance writes through _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes through _approve.
newOwner becomes the new privileged owner, changing the authorization state.
_transfer writes the _balances mapping for sender and recipient.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
balanceOf reads _balances.
allowance reads _allowances.
Constructor assigns _totalSupply.
Constructor assigns _decimals = 6.
Constructor mints the full supply into _balances[owner()].
Initialization path sets _owner to the deployer.
onlyOwner reads the privileged _owner state variable for its check.
transferOwnership reads and then overwrites _owner.
Address.sendValue executes the raw value call to recipient.
_functionCallWithValue executes the arbitrary low-level call.
_callOptionalReturn routes the token call through Address.functionCall.
functionCall forwards data to _functionCallWithValue.
success captures the boolean outcome of the low-level call.
newAllowance is encoded into the approve call executed by _callOptionalReturn.
returndata is the bytes returned by the token call wrapped by functionCall.
The external call to a payable recipient can reenter sendValue's caller before state settles.
An arbitrary target can reenter the contract while _functionCallWithValue is mid-execution.
A malicious token can reenter during the optional-return call in _callOptionalReturn.
1e9 * 10**decimals is computed directly (no SafeMath) when initializing _totalSupply.

normalization_plan.reason: The account parameter exists only to index _balances inside balanceOf and can be folded into that function node.
recipient is the public transfer argument, so it collapses into the transfer function node.
amount is the transfer amount and has no independent semantic identity beyond transfer.
sender is the transferFrom source and is only meaningful within that function.
spender is the approve target key and merges into the approve function.
newOwner only exists to update _owner inside transferOwnership.
addedValue is a purely local allowance delta of increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is a purely local allowance delta of decreaseAllowance.
The success flag only records the result of the unsafe low-level call and can be absorbed into it.
newAllowance is a transient value consumed by the approve call performed in _callOptionalReturn.
returndata merely conveys the bytes returned by functionCall back to its caller.
